_comment: Canonical question-type vocabulary for the exam engine.
WHY THIS IS A SEPARATE FILE
Three places need the same list: the server-side grader (src/lib/exam/grading.ts),
the CI content gate (scripts/validate-content.mjs) and the deeper bank auditor
(scripts/validate-question-bank.ts). They disagreed: the grader and the CI gate
accepted TRUE_FALSE and the read/select variants, while the bank auditor rejected
them as 'invalid question type' — so a bank that the platform grades correctly was
reported as broken by the tool that audits it.
A plain JSON file is used rather than a TypeScript module so the two Node scripts
(one .mjs under plain node, one .ts under bun) and the application runtime can all
read the same list without a build step.
exactly these types, so this file and the schema cannot drift apart either.
